project_type: Next.js 16 app with CLI scripts for CFA question import
build_system: npm with tsx for scripts, Next.js for app build
test_framework: vitest with globals enabled, tests in src/**/*.test.ts
verification_instructions: 1. Run npx tsc --noEmit to type-check. 2. Run npm run test to confirm all tests pass. 3. Run npm run build to confirm Next.js builds.
environment_constraints: No PDF files in sandbox (content/ is gitignored). Validation must be through unit tests with sample text, not actual PDF parsing.
contribution_requirements: Run before every commit: npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test. No TODOs, no placeholders.
key_patterns: Feature-based folders under src/features/{name}/. Tests in __tests__/ subdirectories. Scripts use tsx runner. The import script (src/scripts/import-questions.ts) has its own parseSolutions() function that is SEPARATE from the utility parseAnswers() in src/features/question-bank/utils/question-parser.ts. BOTH need to be fixed to handle all answer formats.
directory_structure: src/scripts/ - CLI tools, src/features/question-bank/ - question bank feature with utils/, types/, __tests__/, src/features/content-scanner/ - has existing test pattern
